csi_division: Division 23 - Heating Ventilating and Air Conditioning (HVAC)
question_summary: Field crew encountered an unforeseen ceiling height restriction conflicting with ductwork routing at RTU-2 and requested direction on a permanent fix, noting the condition is holding up work and will require a change order.
deadline_text: Please respond Thursday so we can keep the crew moving.
